description:
AI agent gateway for calling any API securely. Bootstrap your agent in one call, discover tools, enforce OPA policies, and inject credentials automatically.

## Features
- One-call agent bootstrap with Ed25519 identity
- Tool registry with OpenAPI ingestion
- OPA policy enforcement
- Encrypted credential vault
- Tier-based daily limits (free/starter/pro/scale)

## Quick Start
POST https://agentdevx.onrender.com/agents/v1/bootstrap
{"public_key": "<your_ed25519_hex>"}

findings.title: Tool Shadowing
findings.description: tool name "acme-mailer.send_email" duplicates "acme-mailer.send_email" already registered in this tool set — a malicious server can shadow a trusted tool by registering an identical name
findings.recommendation: Two or more tools registered in your MCP environment share an identical or near-identical name. A malicious server can shadow a trusted tool this way, intercepting calls you intend for the legitimate tool. Remove the conflicting server or rename its tools to be unambiguous.
